tools.name: screen_names
tools.description: Audit-ready sanctions screening of 1 to 100 names against 10 official lists. The response includes a record id, the snapshot version, the data-as-of date for each source list, and the matching engine version. Each screened name costs one credit. Hits are candidates for human review and require furth

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Fetch a previously stored screening record by its record id. This tool is free to use.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: The list_sources tool provides the 10 official sanctions lists and their data-as-of dates from the current daily snapshot. This tool is free to use and does not require an API key.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Retrieve the credit balance for your API key and its latest credit movements. This tool is free to use.
